title: RiverVLN: Phase-Grounded Temporal Vision--Language Navigation for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2609.23423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has largely been developed for indoor and terrestrial robots, where language can often be treated as a static goal and motion is approximated by discrete or near-instantaneous actions. These assumptions break down for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs): river navigation requires continuous motion under inertia and limited maneuverability, while long-horizon instructions must be executed through sparse and visually ambiguous maritime landmarks. We introduce RiverVLN, to our knowledge the first benchmark designed for long-horizon USV VLN under continuous riverine motion, and PGT-NAV, a phase-grounded temporal navigation framework for USVs. Rather than directly mapping an entire instruction to motion, PGT-NAV converts it into an ordered sequence of visually verifiable semantic phases and maintains the active phase online through grounded visual and motion evidence. translated_title: RiverVLN：面向无人水面艇的基于阶段的时序视觉-语言导航
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）此前主要针对室内和陆地机器人发展，在这些场景中，语言通常可以被当作静态目标，运动则通过离散或近似瞬时的动作来近似。这些假设在无人水面艇（USV）上不再成立：河流导航需要在惯性和机动性受限的条件下进行连续运动，而长时程指令必须通过稀疏且视觉上模糊的海事地标来执行。我们提出了RiverVLN，据我们所知，这是首个面向连续河流运动下长时程USV视觉-语言导航的基准数据集，并同时提出了PGT-NAV，一个面向USV的基于阶段的时序导航框架。PGT-NAV并非将整条指令直接映射为运动，而是将其转换为一系列有序的、可视觉验证的语义阶段，并通过有据可依的视觉和运动证据在线维护当前活跃阶段。这一显式的语义进度状态被用于……
tldr: 提出了首个面向无人水面艇在连续河流运动下长时程视觉-语言导航的基准RiverVLN，以及将指令分解为可视觉验证的有序语义阶段并通过视觉与运动证据在线跟踪进度的导航框架PGT-NAV。
en_tdlr: RiverVLN is the first benchmark for long-horizon USV vision-language navigation under continuous riverine motion, paired with PGT-NAV, a framework that decomposes instructions into ordered, visually verifiable semantic phases tracked online through grounded visual and motion evidence.
